title: Residential Rooftop Garden
description: A lush rooftop garden that transforms unused space into a green oasis. This 800 sqft project features a mix of ornamental plants, herbs, and seating areas. The design includes proper waterproofing, drainage systems, and sustainable irrigation. The result is a peaceful retreat that provides fresh air, natural beauty, and a connection to nature.

testimonial.text: Our rooftop has been transformed into a beautiful garden. It's now our favorite place to relax!
testimonial.author: Homeowner

title: Private Garden Design
description: A stunning backyard transformation featuring seasonal flowers, mature trees, and a meandering pathway. This 1200 sqft garden design creates distinct zones for dining, relaxation, and play. Native plants ensure low maintenance while providing year-round color and texture. The design includes ambient lighting for evening enjoyment.

testimonial.text: The garden exceeded our expectations. It's beautiful, easy to maintain, and perfect for our family.
testimonial.author: Homeowner

title: Office Outdoor Space
description: A professional outdoor space designed for employee wellness and client impressions. This 3000 sqft commercial landscape features manicured lawns, shade trees, seating areas, and a modern water feature. The design creates a welcoming entrance while providing employees with a peaceful outdoor break area. Low-maintenance plantings ensure the space looks great year-round.

testimonial.text: The outdoor space has become a valuable asset for our office. Employees love taking breaks here!
testimonial.author: Office Manager
